normalization.denominator: Per request, selected l1_output.json right_reference_polyline XY polyline arc length, in metres
normalization.aggregation: Divide each raw request by its own length, then compute the distribution; never ratio of group medians
normalization.rss: Request sampled peak RSS of Python plus ROS process tree, includes resident map; MiB/m is a scale-normalized ratio, not allocation per metre
